answer: Each agent must allocate 32GB of RAM to a memory-hard work-set to reach the zenith of network participation. A verifier challenges each unit with a lotus-shaped pattern of randomized memory lookups, rejecting any identity that fails to exhibit unique bus-access latency. Honest nodes expend 50 watts, while 1,000 fakes incur an impossible spiral of overhead, assuming unique memory-bus serials and a permanent lockout upon error.
